item.title: President Trump Reportedly Dangling Support For Paramount's WB Bid In Return For More RUSH HOUR Films
item.description: President Trump is said to have a soft spot for Bloodsport and the Rush Hour films and he’d reportedly like to see a Larry Ellison–owned WB revive those franchises with new installments.

item.title: Could This Be Bruce Wayne? James Gunn Replies To Post Fan-Casting SUPERMAN Finalist Tom Brittney As Batman
item.description: James Gunn has curiously responded to a post fan-casting former Superman hopeful as Batman. Could this be a sign DC Studios has found its Dark Knight?
